Chapter 6651: Already Have What You Need

Chapter 6651: Already Have What You Need

Overlord Weizhen’s appearance, albeit unflashy, always left an indelible impression. Those who had seen him couldn’t forget him regardless of how much time had passed.

His master, Zhan Sansheng, once told him: “You already have what you need.”

An immortal of three lifetimes had a high evaluation of him. Even when he was younger and weaker, his master still trusted him more than more powerful disciples and generals.

Thus, he followed his master the longest, from Moshi to Poye. He certainly knew his master’s secrets more than anyone else.

The latter entrusted Supreme Heaven to him but more importantly, he was always the first to see his master after each reincarnation. This meant he knew the pivotal location each time.

Weizhen certainly didn’t let him down despite having relatively average talent among his disciples. Seventy-two Origin Ancestor and One Move Sword Saint.

He was trustworthy in both cultivation and administration. He took it step by step, starting from the most basic merit law. This culminated in him crafting a supreme sword dao.

Thus, some said that despite his relationship with Zhan Sansheng, he learned the least from his master. Because of this, many surpassed him and became primal ancestors while he was stuck in the imperial realm.

However, his solid and dependable style built an incredible foundation. These geniuses became stuck in the primal realm while he became an overlord. The clearest example was none other than the great genius, Seventy-two Origin.

Seventy-two Origin received Moshi’s guidance and was the first to become a primal ancestor after Desolate Ancestor. Everyone respected and even revered him. Unfortunately, he stagnated and fell from the apex stage.

Furthermore, Zhan Sansheng rarely took charge of Supreme Heaven. Weizhen made all the major decisions.

Supreme Heaven was destroyed after many wars. However, it always came back strong under Weizhen’s leadership despite having a monstrous enemy in Life and Death Heaven.

None were surprised to see him participate in this pivotal battle. His allies observed his pace with the highest respect.

“Brother, no need to be in a hurry.” He spoke, ready to defend his legions.

“Your army is already here, a battle is inevitable.” Supreme Black Ancestor said.

“Who shall lead Life and Death Heaven? Senior Desolate Ancestor or Her Majesty?” He asked.

Everyone knew Desolate Ancestor had entered the primordial tree a while back. As for the lord, she clearly had a more important mission.

“I should be asking this question. Is it you, Zhan Sansheng, or the two geezers from the redemption grounds?” Black laughed.

Many worried about the involvement of the two ancient immortals. Life and Death Heaven stood no chance in that case.

“We can’t predict what the immortals will do.” Weizhen answered.

“You’re afraid that you can’t keep them at bay without your master, that they might bite your Supreme Heaven as well.” Black laughed.

Although this could be construed as an attempt to cause a rift between potential allies, it certainly had a hint of truth.

“Can you stop them?” Weizhen answered with a question.

These two ancient immortals had sided with Supreme Heaven all this time and would most likely participate in the battle. On the other hand, Desolate Ancestor was preoccupied with something else.

“I see, you are certain the two geezers will come. Not bad, still in control without Zhan Sansheng.” Black said.

“I’m sure you knew as well, Brother.” Weizhen said.
